reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Insulin" -> "produced by beta cells of pancreas" -> "not produced by alpha cells" -> 5%

analysis: Analyzing the provided options in the context of standard medical knowledge about insulin: Option A is incorrect as insulin is produced by the beta cells of the pancreas, not the alpha cells. Option B states that insulin consists of two polypeptide chains linked by disulfide bonds, which is accurate according to the structure of insulin as understood in biochemistry. Option C is incorrect because insulin actually facilitates the uptake of potassium into cells rather than shifting it outside. Option D is also incorrect as the half-life of subcutaneously injected insulin is much shorter, approximately 5-6 minutes, not 60 minutes. Therefore, the most accurate and medically supported statement is Option B, which aligns with the well-established biochemical structure of insulin.
